note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; the original treats it at species level as Capritermes (Pericapritermes) urgens without distinguishing subspecies, and the nominate subspecies is retained on that basis; only the soldier is described, the worker and the alate are not recorded; the description is based on 5 soldiers; synonymy, figure numbers and localities are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The outer half of the left mandible of C. urgens as figured by Silvestri is more curved than in the specimens of this species, but Emerson judged them to be conspecific; the measurements of the Bipindi specimens come closest to var. nigeriana and may belong to that variety; the specimens also agree with the description of the soldier of C. sodalis Sjöstedt.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, elongate, rectangular, with a line running from the middle of the posterior margin to the opening of the frontal gland. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shorter than segment 3, segments 2 and 3 about equal in length. Mandibles black. Measurements (mm): head length including the mandibles 3.50–3.60, head length to the clypeal margin 2.30, head width 1.07–1.13, antennal length 2.00, pronotal length 0.27, width 0.60, hind tibia length 0.96, left mandible length 1.50.
